tools.name: list_question_sets
tools.description: List available buying-question template sets (local_service, ecommerce_product) and their templates per language.

tools.name: run_visibility_check
tools.description: Fill a question set with values (category, city, country, product, use_case, budget), ask each AI assistant, parse which tracked brands are named and in what position, and score share of voice. Returns run_id and the score table.

tools.name: get_share_of_voice
tools.description: Get the score table for a previous run, optionally with each answer's parsed mentions (brand, position, list rank, sentiment, snippet).
